programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. After all, the ability to change yourself is the truest form of magic. programme.desc: After a few incredible days targeting redfish on the inshore waters of Venice, Louisiana, Eric and Moe Newman bring Rush to the nearshore oil rigs — and that’s where things get wild. The rigs are holding GIANT mangrove snapper, bruiser cobia, and hard-fighting jacks… but getting them to the boat is a whole different story. Fishing heavy structure means short strikes, busted hooks, shredded leaders, and fish that know exactly where to run. Around these rigs it’s not just fishing — it’s full-blown combat. If you want to land one of these beasts, you better bring extra hooks, heavy tackle, and a whole lot of patience. Easier said than done. Venice, Louisiana continues to prove why it’s one of the most action-packed fisheries in the country.

programme.desc: Join us as we kick off Season 7 with an unforgettable adventure north of Cochrane, Ontario, on the pristine waters of Pierre Lake. We team up with Mark Froud from Dunn Right Outfitters, an expert in Northern Ontario fishing, to target trophy walleye. Experience the thrill of reeling in massive catches while surrounded by breathtaking wilderness, and gain valuable tips and insights from Mark to enhance your own fishing techniques. This episode sets the tone for a season filled with excitement, exploration, and exceptional angling.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat El Dorado Takes on Cortez Bank: Part Two
programme.desc: Fishing out west has been fantastic this year, but eventually, the fish move or disappear due to currents, weather, or heavy traffic. However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. With anticipation running high, we can't wait to cast our lines and see what kind of adventures await us on the open waters.

programme.title: Séptimo Día

Angelie, con Diamond Blackfan, recibe un trasplante exitoso. Harvey, policía herido, lucha por su recuperación y justicia.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El 13 de marzo de 2015, en Villa Lozada, La Plata, Huila, cuatro miembros de la familia Ramírez fueron brutalmente asesinados. Aunque inicialmente se sospechó un atraco, la investigación reveló que el crimen fue obra de una banda dedicada al apoderamiento ilegal de terrenos en Ciudad Bolívar, quienes buscaban el millonario botín que la familia guardaba, producto de su negocio de comercialización de café.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2010, en Putumayo, Myriam Zamora fue acusada de asesinar a sus dos pequeños hijos e intentar suicidarse. Aunque ella se declaró víctima y refutó las acusaciones de la Fiscalía y de su esposo durante el proceso, no logró presentar pruebas que respaldaran su versión. Sin evidencia que sustentara su inocencia, fue condenada y pasará varios años tras las rejas.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El 17 octubre del 2015, en el corregimiento de Belén, en El Banco Magdalena, dos hombres abusaron y asesinaron a Valeria Peña, una menor de 15 años que logró sobrevivir antes los ataques y dejar un testimonio donde señalaba a José Fernando López como el autor material de su crimen. Sin embargo, un tercer testimonio involucro al hermano de José Fernando y el autor intelectual quien tenía claras intenciones de venganza.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2007, María Cecilia Viva Salas desapareció en Buenaventura, generando conmoción en su barrio. Inicialmente se sospechó de pandilleros, pero la investigación reveló que su esposo Harvey era el responsable. Su hija Pilar, testigo silenciada por miedo, finalmente reveló pistas clave. El rastreo del celular llevó a su cuerpo, hallado en su propia casa. Harvey confesó y fue condenado a 18 años, aunque salió libre tras cumplir la mitad de la pena.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Deibis Mildred y Adolfo González formaron una familia y un negocio exitoso de confecciones en Riohacha. En 2008, Adolfo fue asesinado en su casa, un crimen inicialmente sin resolver. Tres años después, las sospechas recayeron sobre Deibis Mildred, señalada de planear el homicidio junto a un amante para cobrar un seguro de vida. Fue condenada a 40 años de cárcel como coautora del asesinato.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2008, Nidia Yazmín González, madre soltera de 37 años, fue hallada muerta en el río Gámeza, Boyacá, con signos de brutal violencia. Mantenía una relación secreta con Alirio Castro, un hombre casado, posesivo y celoso. Pruebas clave —su cinturón negro en karate y un historial de maltrato— lo señalaron como responsable. Absuelto en 2009, la fiscalía apeló y en 2011 fue condenado a 33 años de prisión.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Giovanny Padilla, registrador en La Jagua de Ibirico, fue asesinado el 1 de enero de 2018 en Valledupar. Dos jóvenes, Emanuel Castro y Jesús Sánchez, lo torturaron para robarle. Ambos fueron capturados y condenados.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Elaine Palacio, la única modelo colombiana en portadas de Vogue Italia y ángel de Victoria's Secret, nació en Puerto Boyacá enfrentando racismo y baja autoestima. A los 15 años se fue a Medellín y luego a México, donde fue víctima de explotación laboral, viviendo con solo 40 dólares mientras cargaba una deuda ficticia. Se reinventó, recuperó su carrera y fundó "Negros de Corazón" para impulsar a jóvenes afrocolombianos.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.sub-title: Ohio State University vs. University of Florida
programme.desc: The atmosphere reaches a fever pitch as the Ohio State Buckeyes and Florida Gators face off in a high-stakes battle for the 2023 DUPR Collegiate National Championship. Referee Kate Johnson sets the tone early, enforcing strict regulations on net contact and service line precision to ensure every point is earned through pure grit. Spectators will witness an intense racing flow as players scramble for kitchen control, showcasing the technical skills required to navigate high-speed volleys and strategic double bounces. With Florida utilizing critical timeouts to regroup against Ohio State’s relentless pressure, the match transforms into a display of freestyle athleticism and raw competitive spirit. Don’t miss a second of the action as these elite collegiate athletes fight to keep their championship dreams alive.

programme.sub-title: WPBL 2026 - Bengaluru vs Rajasthan - Day 9 Tie 1
programme.desc: Experience the high-octane energy of the World Pickleball League (WPBL) Season 2 as the Bengaluru Jawans go head-to-head with the Rajasthan Titans at the iconic Jio World Garden in Mumbai. The stakes are higher than ever in this Day 9, Tie 16 clash, featuring elite matchups such as the "women's singles player of the season" Katrina Stewart facing off against the resilient Lorena Dupnik. With game-changing "Pickle Plays" and atmospheric "drums" fueling the intensity, this tie is a masterclass in professional grit and strategic precision.

programme.title: The Wager
programme.sub-title: Troubadour Club 2024 – Exhibition Match – Johnson & East vs Kennedy & Burrows
programme.desc: Set at the scenic Troubadour Golf and Field Club in Nashville, TN, this exhibition match brings a mix of celebrity flair and friendly competition to the pickleball court. Olympian Shawn Johnson and her husband Andrew East take on TV host Jason Kennedy and pro Wes Burrows in a lighthearted yet tightly contested match that goes down to the wire. With Shawn still learning the ropes (and the rules), and Andrew channeling his athletic instincts, the duo puts up an impressive fight against the more experienced Kennedy and Burrows. It’s a fast-paced, fun-filled match full of laughs, learning moments, and great rallies—perfect for fans of lifestyle sports and celebrity matchups.

programme.sub-title: WPBL 2026 - Mumbai Pickle Power vs. Delhi World - Day 2 Tie 1

programme.title: Picklebowl 2022

US Olympian Casey Patterson and pickleball pro Chuck Taylor join forces to take on pickleball standout Megan Fudge and former tennis world No. 5 Kevin Anderson. Set against the scenic backdrop of Sea Island, Georgia, this unique event blends elite pickleball play with charity and college pride. Expect explosive rallies, pinpoint accuracy, and powerful serves in this high-energy exhibition that showcases the crossover appeal of pickleball.

Former GLORY title contender & leading Japanese fighter Kento Haraguchi (28-6-1, 18 KO) will go up against talented newcomer Hiroki Kasahara (39-8, 17 KO) while popular South Korean veteran Sung-hyun Lee (71-13-2, 17 KO) takes on top young prospect Yura Kono (17-1, 9 KO). programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Amenazas por Facebook; Esposa millonaria vieja
programme.desc: David subió un video en Facebook donde dice que va a matar a su amiga; piden una orden de alejamiento. Camilo quiere sacar a su mujer de la casa y quedarse con la sirvienta que se ganó la lotería.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Depredador injusto; Padre stripper, scary boyfriend
programme.desc: María le exige a su marido que desaloje a su hermano por ser un depredador sexual, ella teme por su niña. Un padre acusa a la madre de su hijo de ser drogadicta y pide la patria potestad.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Cocaína para pre eyaculación; Legalización venta de órganos
programme.desc: Camilo usa cocaína como remedio para su eyaculación precoz; la esposa denuncia que la drogó. Un padre quiere comprar un riñón en Irán para su hija, pero la madre demanda que se lo prohíban.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Hijo preso por defender a novia; Lesbianas odian a los hombres
programme.desc: El hijo de Melba está preso en Colombia por defender a su novia; la mamá pide que ella lo ayude. Mario quiere quitarle su hija a Elly, alega que ella la contamina con odio hacia los hombres.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Youtube reina del toilet; Se inyecta pene
programme.desc: Un hombre planea convertir a su esposa en "la reina del toilet". Elizabeth, su suegra, pide una orden de alejamiento. Iván se inyecta un medicamento en el pene para más potencia; su esposa quiere el divorcio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La chismosa de la farándula; Esposo cojo, esposa asexual
programme.desc: La Pitonisa exige una orden de alejamiento por agresión contra la cantante Nati. Pedro quiere divorciarse de Ana, quien alega ser asexual. Pedro asegura que ella lo rechaza porque le falta una pierna.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El barbero del bichote; Riñón por virginidad
programme.desc: Nathaniel le exige a Medi que le devuelva la custodia de su sobrino. Carla le dona un riñón al hombre que ama a cambio de que le quite su virginidad. Ahora la esposa demanda a la donante.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Con leucemia entrega hija; Casanova persa
programme.desc: John exige la custodia de la hija que su hermano, preso, tuvo con Franchesca, quien sufre leucemia. Daniela solicita extender la orden de alejamiento para Hamed porque la agredió varias veces.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Rumpólogo: Lectura de nalga; Sugar Daddy de universidad
programme.desc: Nataly va a que le predigan el futuro a través de sus nalgas; su esposo no lo tolera y solicita la custodia del niño que tienen en común. Jorge se llevó a Evelyn a su casa, pero ahora pide su desalojo; ella quiere una compensación.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Musulmán discriminado - ISIS; Ayuda para Ana
programme.desc: Eduardo, musulmán, fue despedido por defender a los terroristas de ISIS. Ahora solicita 100 mil dólares de indemnización. Carol teme que Ana se suicide y exige que la internen en un psiquiátrico.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Exnovia mando 77 mil txt msgs; Mamá dona riñón con tumor
programme.desc: Leopoldo demanda una orden de alejamiento para Paula, su exnovia, porque lo acosa. Karla espera incapacitar a su mamá, quien es diabética y va a donarle un riñón a su novio menor que ella.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Abuela toma baños de luna; Grupo oro sólido
programme.desc: Yuri quiere que alejen a Ana de su abuela de 87 años porque la induce a fumar marihuana. La bailarina Lina intenta anular un contrato con Felipe, ya que él pretende que ella baile desnuda.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Esposo chavista; Ayuda para hermana de crianza
programme.desc: Edgar es antichavista y no acepta que su exmujer se lleve a su hija a Venezuela con su nuevo esposo chavista. Shariz le exige a Hilda que busque ayuda para su hermana de crianza, Nayla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El embarque de Luisa; Joven sin ganas de vivir
programme.desc: Lázaro le hizo una promesa a San Lázaro y ahora se viste como el santo, por eso Luisa se va a divorciar. Martín tiene una enfermedad terminal y piensa quitarse la vida; su madre pide que lo salven.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mónica exige anular un contrato que firmó con Ricardo, su ex yerno, y con su hija. Mónica se prestó para ser madre subrogada, pero ahora su hija y su yerno se separaron y Mónica quiere abortar a la criatura.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El órgano que nunca tuve; Gusano come carne
programme.desc: Juan nació sin miembro viril. Aunque pudo casarse, quiere injertarse un pene. Cristina exige una indemnización por la muerte de su esposo, quien murió a causa de un gusano que se come la piel.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Niño nena de mamá; Mamá, paga por tu abandono
programme.desc: Un niño que se siente mujer desde su nacimiento decidió tomar hormonas femeninas para iniciar su cambio de sexo. Magdalena fue abandonada por su mamá y demanda 18 mil dólares de manutención.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El vampireso; 10 años sin ver a papá
programme.desc: Alondra exige terapia psicológica para su esposo Luis, quien está obsesionado con una famosa llamada Vampy. María pide que su madre le permita hablar con su padre, a quien daba por muerto.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Cristina le exige 10 mil dólares a su esposo, Alejandro, por abuso sexual. Saúl intenta obligar a Alejandra a que le permita usar sus ahorros para que su suegra tenga una muerte asistida.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Helado de viagra; Las mujeres del gatillero
programme.desc: Daniela le dio a Juan un helado de viagra que lo volvió un pervertido; ahora él la demanda por 25 mil dólares. Teixeira exige que la amante de su esposo le dé las propiedades y joyas que él le regaló.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Jorge y su amante quedaron enganchados como dos perritos y tuvieron que llamar a emergencias. Carmen se niega a devolverle la custodia de su hija a Aurora, alega que no está preparada.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: Gabriela fue arrestada, humillada y despedida de su empleo porque Ricardo dio información personal sin permiso de ella. Un niño murió atropellado por su tío. La tragedia pesa sobre la familia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Ni arrastrada voy al bootcamp; Viuda sin beneficios
programme.desc: Doris exige que le devuelvan la custodia de sus hijas; Carlos alega que ella tiene que curarse primero. Todos los beneficios de la esposa militar de Mariana se los dieron al exmarido.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Niña huelga de hambre FB; Quien me mate hereda
programme.desc: Una mujer utiliza la imagen de su hija como si la niña estuviera en huelga de hambre. En su testamento, un anciano aseguró que quien lo mate durante el sexo heredará todos sus bienes.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Educando para drag queen; Casi un niño pagando manutención
programme.desc: Natasha denuncia que Gabriel quiere convertir a su hijo pequeño en drag queen. Carmen exige congelar una cuenta de ahorros que le abrió a su hijo; él le quiere dar un uso distinto al dinero.

programme.desc: El hijo de Manuel va a salir de la cárcel y él quiere desalojar a su nuera y quedarse con la custodia de su nieto. Un matrimonio está en crisis porque un cónyuge perdonó al asesino de su hija.

programme.desc: The abandoned churches in the Texas countryside are scary. But did you know that some of them are haunted as well? Join Colin as he explores some religious spots where ghosts were supposedly seen.

programme.title: Paranormal Files
programme.desc: The Old Bridge Ranch in Reno is an abandoned building so scary that some of the members of Twin Paranormal will NEVER set foot in it again... but Colin wanted to go in, so they explored this scary old place and captured some creepy paranormal activity on camera. Is this place really as SCARY as so many people claim that it is? Watch to find out...

programme.title: Paranormal Files
programme.sub-title: The Quarantine look at the Conjuring Part 1
programme.desc: The TRUE STORY behind the CONJURING haunted house is explored during this STAR STUDDED "Paranormal Files" special. Colin interviewed the current residents of "The Conjuring" house, talked to Andrea Perron, a paranormal survivor who worked along with Ed and Lorraine Warren during the initial haunting of the house and a bunch of paranormal celebrities, including Dave Schrader, Susan Slaughter, Bridget Marquardt and more! If you like ghost stories and paranormal storytime, then THIS VIDEO is for you! Part 1

programme.title: Aliens Uncovered
programme.sub-title: Aliens Uncovered: Marilyn Monroe Exposed Part 1
programme.desc: As tensions spike between the US and the Soviet Union, UFO sightings begin to take a turn. With abductions and close encounters, did the President attempt to disclose that info in an unorthodox way, warning humanity of what was to come?

programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.sub-title: Mill Race Monster, Toxic Rain, Devil Dogs
programme.desc: Everyday people share first-hand accounts of their close encounters with real-life folktale fiends. From legendary monsters and ancient spirits to UFOs and unexplained phenomena, the most frightening tales are revealed.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Wilker y Yubiri siguen besándose. Cada uno de ellos pensando en lo feliz que se sienten. El se despide de ella y quedan en no hablarse más. Carolina le forma un escándalo a Segundo por besarla pero piensa que le gusta más que los besos de Juan Diego. Se van del local. Atanasio sigue aconsejando a Juan Diego en lo que se refiere a las mujeres. Wilker anima a su mamá a que se consiga un novio para que la acompañe. Ella le dice que no | que lo que quieres es que se case y tenga bastantes nietos.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel León es un famoso presentador televisivo famoso por su vitalidad y buena presencia pero en uno de sus programas sufre un desmayo y entonces va al médico y este le dice que deberá hacer un tratamiento de diálisis o hacerse un trasplante. Gabriel le confiesa esta verdad a su manager y amigo Epicúreo y también le dice que el donante será uno de sus hijos que no conoce pero que sabe que existen porque cuando tenía 18 años fue donante de esperma y le encarga a Epicúreo que se ocupe de encontrar a esos hijos. Epicúreo se hace pasar por diferentes roles y consigue la información que Gabriel estaba buscando o al menos algo de ella.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Amparo revela a Moisés que su padre está vivo, desatando tensiones familiares mientras Elizabeth exige la verdad. Benjamín anuncia su boda con Hortensia, provocando el rechazo de Ricardo, quien exige separación de bienes. Alejandro intenta disuadir a su padre de una venganza sangrienta tras salir de prisión. Mientras tanto, Gustavo busca a María del Pilar pese a que ella ya está con Marcelo, y Manuela rechaza la propuesta de Misael en medio de conflictos familiares y sociales.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Adolfo reclama a Isaías por el dinero perdido y lo acusa de vivir con Rosa; Isaías defiende a Rosa diciendo que podría ser su hija. Salvador rompe con Vilma quien jura venganza. Erasto descubre que el dinero desapareció y culpa a Eustoquio. Junior se enfrenta a Rosa por Isaías y cae desmayado; ella lo lleva a la clínica gritando auxilio. Alejandro enfrenta a Erasto y lo amenaza con la Fiscalía. Erasto coloca camisa de fuerza a Natalia y la golpea. Carmen Rosa explica a Chencha por qué calla la verdad sobre Consuelo, jurándole no revelar nunca el secreto.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene y Leonardo vuelven del viaje y Felipe los espera ansioso. Alejandra se entera de que se filtró un correo donde piden a alguien para su puesto y confronta a Leonardo, quien la saca violentamente de su oficina. Rodrigo amenaza a Rebeca con revelar todo el plan si Adolfo y ella deciden traicionarlos. Además, le pregunta qué pasaría si se supiera que ella es la asesina de Miguel Ferrándiz. Anzola le declara su amor a Trinidad y esta lo rechaza. Jimena tiene una dura conversación con Carlos Ernesto en la cual él le pide que lo deje amar a Virginia. Luego, Jimena se enfrenta a Virginia y le confiesa que tiene dudas sobre la autoría del crimen. Virginia le dice que ama a Carlos Ernesto y que luchará con todo para limpiar su nombre.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: El socio de Heriberto lo visita en la cárcel para confesarle que ahora se alió con Reina para secuestrar a Alejandro, ya que ella le pagará más.Reina lleva sedado a Alejandro a un hotel y lo hace pasar por parapléjico, pero cuando sale olvida su teléfono, y Alejandro aprovecha para llamar a Sol y contarle que lo tienen ahí, y también pedirle que llame a la policía. Luego Reina regresa antes que Alejandro escape, y se lo lleva junto a su nuevo socio en una camioneta.

programme.desc: Carlos Ernesto y Leonardo hablan acerca de las sospechas del segundo sobre la verdadera paternidad de Mateo, el hijo de Irene. Sin que ellos lo sepan, Rebeca los está escuchando. Virginia y Jimena se reconcilian y le comunican la buena nueva a Carlos Ernesto, quien se muestra feliz y agradecido. Leo es liberado de la cárcel y se reencuentra con su padre. En una molesta discusión, pregunta si cuando se vuelvan a casar, van a firmar la separación de bienes. programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Heriberto logra escapar de la cárcel y le pasa información a Maricielo sobre el posible escondite al que Reina irá con Alejandro. La policía consigue dar con los secuestradores y recuperar sano y salvo a Alejandro, pero Reina se da a la fuga. A último momento, es interceptada por las patrullas. Luego, Heriberto se dirige a la casa de Sol y le dice que ha ayudado a la policía para recuperar a Alejandro. Ella confía en él pero, al momento de brindar, Heriberto le pone una droga en su bebida.

programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders (2023)
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Sugar is commonly known on the island as the Mauritian Miracle, having once been the backbone of Mauritius's economy. Brent visits L'Adventure du Sucre museum and gets a fascinating look at how the Mauritian history is tightly intertwined with sugar. He then heads in to the fields to for some fun cutting cane before meeting up with Chef Oliver and who shows Brent just how much Mauritians love sugar and spice. Brent then heads out to the stunning and exclusive island, Ile Des Deux Cocos, for some snorkeling in a marine sanctuary and then cooks up his own Mauritian tropical desert on a remote coral beach.

programme.title: Sarah Graham’s Food Safari
programme.desc: Food blogger and cookbook author, Sarah Graham, takes her kitchen on the road through Africa.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In our first episode, you find us at a boatyard in the small fishing town of Chioggia - at the southern end of the Venice Lagoon, preparing the yacht for its voyage. We will show you around this lovely town, and introduce you to some of the colourful people we’ve come to know here over the years. Chioggia is the busiest fishing port on all of mainland Italy; we will take you to its fish markets, and meet a restaurateur in the kitchen of one of Chioggia’s finest restaurants to see the chefs cook some local specialties. We also go fishing with a father and son, who practice an ancient tradition of net and pole fishing on the Venetian Lagoon. They are called moecanti.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In this second episode, we sail into Venice and visit our friend Renato, who has been the head chef at the Cipriani Hotel for over 25 years and has travelled the world as a food ambassador. Renato invites us into his kitchen to make some of his best-loved Venetian dishes. We then visit the famous Rialto markets and cook a few of my favourites in the yacht’s galley. We conclude our Venice adventure by visiting some friends at an old gondola repair yard called a squero. It has been converted into a private retreat featuring an impressive kitchen, from which we experience a memorable Venetian cook-up.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In this episode, we sail all the way to southern Turkey to visit the picturesque village of Kaleköy in the Kekova area. We introduce you to a local family who run the Likya restaurant, and serve simple delicious Turkish food. We’ve known them for over 30 years, ever since we began sailing here. We also discover how the locals love the carob bean, and how they make a tasty, healthy syrup from it. Finally, we’ll introduce you to our friend Kadriye who cooks up a typical Turkish lunch, and one of her neighbours demonstrates how to make the local pancake called gözleme.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: As our long voyage from Venice continues, we sail from Kastellorizo to Lindos on the island of Rhodes. This is where Patrick and I married, over 30 years ago. In Lindos, we take you to the Melenos kitchen; where the chef, Gogo, will show us her very modern & healthy take on traditional Greek cuisine. We visit Rhodes, where I used to teach ballet, and show you how to prepare artichokes with vinaigrette sauce, the dish that Patrick prepared for me on our very first date! Finally, we visit my godfather, Vangelis, who shows us how to prepare some authentic everyday Greek food.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.sub-title: Food Sail Love: Symi, Santorini, Corinth
programme.desc: In this episode, we will take you to the beautiful Greek island of Symi, where the amphitheatrical harbour displays its distinctive neo classical architecture, very specific to this particular corner of the Aegean. Here we’ll recapture old memories, and cook the local delicacy - Symi shrimps. Our next stop is the extraordinary island of Santorini, where we will celebrate their famous tomatoes, grown in the rich volcanic soil. Finally, we head northwest to the mouth of the Corinth canal - the location of one of our all-time favourite seafood restaurants in the Mediterranean. It’s called Kavos and is run by Pagona and her son, Tassos.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.sub-title: Food Sail Love: Amalfi & Sestri Levante
programme.desc: In this episode, we will sail through the Corinth canal in Greece, cross to the boot of Italy and sail all the way up the west coast to Liguria, to one of our favourite towns – Sestri Levante. On the way, we will stop at Galaxidi, halfway up the Gulf of Corinth, for breakfast after which I will prepare a Moussaka in the galley – under sail. We will then take you to Amalfi and the bay of Naples to pay homage to their lemons and to the Caprese salad, before arriving in the village of Sestri Levante to experience some delicious Ligurian dishes.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In Portofino, we’ll be shown how to make the authentic version of pesto alla Genovese, by chef Corrado at the legendary Hotel Splendido. We will then visit the Canale bakery to see how they make the famous local bread called focaccia; and after that, we will meet up with my dear friend Nina on the yacht in Portofino’s iconic harbour, which is where we met over 25 years ago. She wants to show us how to make a couple of delicious dishes, in the galley.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In this, the final episode, we sail along the French Riviera and catch up with some of the people and places we know and love. This region is particularly dear to Patrick; he was born in Marseille and spent all of his childhood summers on this coast. First, we’ll visit St Tropez, including the iconic Club 55; then we’ll take you to Antibes and to a couple of nearby villages, St Paul de Vence and Biot. Each has a restaurant which we count among our favourites, and they have two things in common – traditional Provençal food… and art, which in each case is largely its raison d’être.

programme.title: Operation Plunder The Rhine Crossing
programme.desc: This program covers the growth of German aggression, 1934-1940. Contains many animated maps explaining German tactics and many views of Adolf Hitler making speeches and in conferences. Shows a large Nazi rally and Axis-inspired riots in Belgium and France. Also shows a Nazi rally in Madison Square Garden. Included is footage of Joachim von Ribbentrop and Fritz Kuhn.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: The Communist invasion of Korea which led to the entry of the US Forces into the conflict.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Roosevelt, Churchill, and Stalin congregate at the Teheran Conference in 1943. U.S. troops land and fight on Kwajalein, Eniwetok, Saipan, Guam, and other Pacific islands. Russian troops advance to Romania and capture German soldiers. Paratroops jump at Caen. Citizens of Rome, Paris, Bucharest, Brussels, Belgrade, and Athens celebrate their liberation. F.D.R. addresses the United Nations.

programme.title: WWII: Mysteries in the Archives 1938-1948
programme.desc: In 1946, Tokyo, top Japanese officials are tried for war crimes by an international tribunal.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.sub-title: Big Picture: United Nations Consolidate Below the 38th Parallel
programme.desc: Destruction of the Port of Hungnam...The withdrawal across the Han...U.N. defenses at Suwon...and air attacks on the Chinese border. Captain Zimmerman interviews two soldiers, Corporal Tom Miller who was a rifleman with the 1st Cavalry Division in Korea and Corporal James Jankowski of McDonald, Pennsylvania, who served with Company L in the Army's 2nd Division.

programme.title: World of Warships Clash of Titans
programme.desc: In 1941, Japan attacks Pearl Harbor, aiming to destroy the U.S. fleet and control the Pacific.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: Tracking the main events of WWII with the help of archive footage.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: Tracking the main events of WWII with the help of archive footage.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.sub-title: D-Day - The Battle in the Air
programme.desc: Gen. Eisenhower addresses troops in Southern England; the 'Big Show' begins; airborne troops dropped behind enemy lines; support aircraft drop everything from howitzers to motorcycles; bombers blast bridges and supply lines; sea forces bombard enemy fortifications on French coast; British and second army swarm over coast at Omaha and Utah Beaches; German west wall broken.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: The Greatest coordination of arms ever portrayed in the world. Every scene made during the greatest victory of Allied power, to date. 11,000 Allied planes plant their tons of pulverizing bombs on shore installations, strategic roads and bridges, then swoop down to strafe enemy trains, ships and planes. The air poundings continue, and the mop-up search for snipers is on. The invasion is successful.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: French civilians and U.S. Army engineers repair and salvage railroad yards, bridges, and trains.

programme.title: Combat War Channel
programme.desc: Valley Forge...Gettysburg...Wounded Knee...San Juan Hill...the Somme...Omaha Beach...Inchon...Saigon...Basra. Combat War Channel delivers the complete history of America and our allies at war as never before!

programme.title: Combat War Channel
programme.desc: Valley Forge...Gettysburg...Wounded Knee...San Juan Hill...the Somme...Omaha Beach...Inchon...Saigon...Basra. Combat War Channel delivers the complete history of America and our allies at war as never before!

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: Germany is retreating on all fronts and suffering defeat after defeat. The breach of Germany's pre-War borders now seems inevitable. Desperate, Hitler orders all males between the ages of 16 and 70 to enlist and fight for the fatherland. Nazi ideologues put faith in victory and the Nazis seem to vanquish and suppress all forms of doubt and resistance in the last months of the Reich.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.sub-title: Hitler's Death Army - Part II: Death and Decline
programme.desc: With recolorized archives, this episode explores the final year of Hitler's infamous division. From recruitment and indoctrination to their last missions, we uncover who these men were-and how they became perpetrators of mass murder. Following their brutal combat and crimes against humanity, we confront the chaos, ideology, and horror that defined the Das Reich's final descent.

programme.title: Complete History of Air Combat
programme.sub-title: Vietnam and the Limits of Strategic Bombing
programme.desc: A closer look at the scope of the U.S air power during the Vietnam war. See how air power changed the war, from bomb showers by the Republic F-105 Thunderchief, to C-123 Providers crashing, intended to supply provisions and air lift soldiers and civilians.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: In mid-August 1944, the Allies launched 'Operation Anvil' to increase pressure on German troops after the Normandy landings. The 517th Airborne was tasked with preventing enemy tanks from reaching the beachhead. This episode recounts the story of three American sergeants and a British major who jumped into enemy territory, successfully completed their mission, and survived to tell the tale.

programme.title: Combat War Channel
programme.desc: Valley Forge...Gettysburg...Wounded Knee...San Juan Hill...the Somme...Omaha Beach...Inchon...Saigon...Basra. Combat War Channel delivers the complete history of America and our allies at war as never before!

programme.title: Combat War Channel
programme.desc: Valley Forge...Gettysburg...Wounded Knee...San Juan Hill...the Somme...Omaha Beach...Inchon...Saigon...Basra. Combat War Channel delivers the complete history of America and our allies at war as never before!

programme.title: The Amazing World of War Machines
programme.desc: Beneath the waves lurks a stealthy war machine. Capable of carrying nuclear weapons, submarines play a key role in the defense of many countries around the world today. The earliest beginnings of submarines can be traced back to the time of Alexander the Great in 323 B.C. In 1776 American inventor David Bushnell designed and constructed the first military submarine.

programme.title: Wings of Destruction
programme.desc: Both sides utilized air power during the Vietnam War, but the United States ruled the skies. The American pilots often were the factors that turned the fortunes of battles by interrupting enemy supply lines and communications, as well as gathering reconnaissance information for the ground troops. Despite the overwhelming success, it didn't produce victory. Vietnam air tactics broke the prior mold.

programme.title: Rommel's Afrika Korps Defeated
programme.desc: 1943 Axis Smashed in North Africa After battles across North Africa Montgomery and Eisenhower's armies meet up. Tunisia is liberated and the celebration is seen as a forerunner of victories to come in Europe. Vivid wartime footage.

programme.title: Battlefields
programme.desc: June 5th, 1944, 9:30 PM. 13,348 men from two American parachute divisions, the 82nd and the 101st Airborne in nearly 1,000 aircraft will take off to Normandy. Until then, no one had launched an airborne operation of this scale. The Allied staff is expecting huge losses! Some forecasts predict 75% of the paratroopers will fall in combat. They must open the way to the troops landing on Utah Beach.

programme.title: Amor en el Rancho
programme.desc: Allison Sawyer es la reportera de cabecera del Metropolis Post, conocida por sus reportajes de alto nivel. Su próxima historia es escribir el perfil de una de sus autoras favoritas, Annabelle Lee. Annabelle basa todas sus novelas románticas en el hermoso e intemporal rancho Clybourne, lejos de la vida de la ciudad. Allison va al rancho y conoce a Hank y a su adorable abuela Stella, que llevan años regentando juntos el lugar.

programme.title: Cambio De Rumbo (2012)
programme.desc: Después de recibir malas noticias sobre la salud de su padre, James regresa a casa de mala gana para ayudar con el negocio familiar, un alojamiento y desayuno. Allí se enfrenta a un trabajo servil que abandonó con entusiasmo antes, y a un hermano con el que no se lleva bien. Aunque anhela irse tan pronto como pueda, descubre que el negocio está teniendo problemas. James enfrenta las tensiones con su hermano y debe decidir qué está dispuesto a sacrificar por los que ama.

programme.title: Aprendiendo A Amar (2023)
programme.desc: Cuando su novio la deja, Steph se muda a Los Ángeles y acepta un trabajo como tutora de las hijas de un exitoso arquitecto en los Hamptons. Todo parece perfecto hasta que surgen sentimientos entre ellos, y las niñas deciden intervenir antes de que el romance se venga abajo.

programme.title: Alimento para El Corazón (2023)
programme.desc: Los planes de la chef Lia de ampliar su servicio sin ánimo de lucro de reparto de comida a domicilio centrado en el corazón fracasan debido a su insistencia en hacerlo todo ella misma. Pero con la ayuda de su nuevo vecino y reciente padre adoptivo Eli descubrirá que los negocios, al igual que el romance, pueden florecer con un poco de esfuerzo y confianza.

programme.title: Una Amistad Diferente (2017)
programme.desc: Después de un período de servicio, una enfermera del ejército regresa a la granja de su abuela en un país Amish. Encuentra un romance inesperado con Grace, quien acude a ella para llevar a su mamá al hospital y se ve envuelta en un misterio de asesinato.

programme.title: Amor De Mentira
programme.desc: Cuando Sarah Goldman, una encantadora y joven maestra de escuela en Chicago, quiere complacer a sus padres, se inventa un novio que cree que será el hombre de los sueños de su madre. Cuando sus padres insisten en conocerlo, Sarah contrata a Bob, un actor, para que se haga pasar por su novio.

programme.title: Enfoque De Amor
programme.desc: Cuando el programa de televisión que protagoniza la actriz Jenna Wilde se cancela repentinamente, la prensa empieza a rodearla. Para escapar del caos, Jenna se retira a una cabaña nevada en las montañas. Inesperadamente, debe compartir este apacible lugar con Chris Dixon, un fotógrafo de naturaleza. Su frialdad mutua empieza a descongelarse cuando Chris ayuda a Jenna a presentarse a las audiciones de otros programas.

programme.title: El Amor no Necesita Traducción
programme.desc: Julie Walters, estudiante de doctorado en lingüística, habla casi todos los idiomas imaginables. Es una gran creyente de que los idiomas se aprenden mejor haciendo actividades divertidas. Las cosas se ponen patas arriba para Julie cuando un empleado de un museo se pone en contacto con ella para que le dé clases de francés.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Después de miles de horas de preparación minuciosa y vuelo peligroso, un terrible accidente devasta a la tripulación de los bombarderos de agua en Turquía, y a todos en Buffalo. programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Former teacher Tanya Ramirez pled guilty for crossing a forbidden line… having sex with a 17-year-old student who attended the school where she taught, and now, she’s done something many find even more unbelievable, she’s suing him and his mother. After pleading guilty to this charge, Ramirez filed a lawsuit against the teen accusing him of “extreme and outrageous” conduct and invasion of privacy for recording their late-night rendezvous. Ramirez claims the teen showed the tape around school for bragging rights. Ramirez says the sex was consensual, and says the student is an adult and he was just fine after the encounter. Teacher and student face off on Dr. Phil’s stage for the first time.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Some teachers today are turning schoolboy fantasies into sexual realities with their inappropriate conduct towards underage students. Mary Kay Letourneau, who admitted to authorities that she had sex with a 13-year-old former student; Debra Lafave, accused of having sex with a 14-year-old student, and Pamela Rogers, accused of sending sexually-explicit videos to a 14-year-old boy, are just a few examples.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If you're a parent having an extramarital affair " whether it's physical or emotional " should you tell your children? Or, if you're thinking about getting a divorce, how much should the kids know and when should they know it? Dr. Phil meets with a family torn apart over one parent's desire for a divorce.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Have you ever hidden cash or a bill from your spouse? Do you think your partner is telling you the truth about his or her debt? A recent study found that one in three people admit that they lie to their spouses about money. Dr. Phil’s guest, Crystine, says she’s told her husband, Tom, so many lies, she can’t keep track of them, and she’s scared Tom will divorce her when he finds out the truth. Is Crystine ready to spill the beans about her money secrets and will she change her deceitful ways? And, Debbie admits she shopped herself into debt and out of her past three marriages. She says she could open a store with the amount of clothing and accessories she has in her house -- many with the tags still attached -- and can’t go two days without buying something new. Find out what happened 10 years ago that kick-started her urge to overspend. Her boyfriend, Ron, says their relationship can’t move forward until she gets her shopping under control. Are you guilty of financial infidelity? Find out how you compare to Dr. Phil’s studio audience as he polls them about their spending habits!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Mom Tried To Kill Autistic Child (Pt. 1)
programme.desc: In September 2013, Kelli Stapleton and her 14-year-old daughter, Issy -- who suffers from severe autism -- were found in the family van, suffering from carbon monoxide poisoning. Could Kelli have done the unthinkable? In a Dr. Phil exclusive, the jailed Michigan mom opens up about what happened.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil talks to mothers-in-law feuding with their sons-in-law and the relatives caught in the crossfire of these ongoing feuds. Greg and Amy have only been married for 10 months, but the couple says Amy’s mom, Terry, is ruining their relationship. Greg says his mother-in-law is manipulative and controlling, and she even called Child Protective Services on him for allegedly abusing Amy’s young children. Terry says Greg curses all the time, can’t keep a job and made her 5-year-old grandson wear a diaper to school as punishment for sucking his thumb -- a claim Greg denies. Is Terry a meddling mother-in-law or just a concerned grandmother? Then, Donna, says her son-in-law, Steve, is an abusive parent who hits her grandchildren. Steve refutes this and says his mother-in-law is a “man-hater” trying to ruin his marriage. Donna’s daughters, Rochelle and Shannon, speak up about the family drama, and you’ll be surprised to learn who they think is to blame. Whose side are you on? Tune in and decide!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A Mother-in -Law accuses her Daugher-in-Law of political corruption, and even murder. Can these two call a truce with the help of Dr Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you consider yourself smart, yet continue to make bad choices? This New Year, stop setting yourself up for pain and problems and put all the drama and bad choices in the rearview mirror! Dr. Phil says ex-spouses Jennifer and Phil are the perfect example of intelligent people whose choices could lead to terrible consequences. Since their divorce five years ago, they have been at war, and their three children are caught on the battleground. Jennifer says her “sperm donor” of an ex-husband doesn’t make enough of an effort to see their children and owes her nearly $30,000 in back child support. Phil says Jennifer is a habitual liar who “infects” the kids with lies about him and is on a mission to keep the kids from him. Dr. Phil doesn’t mince words when he tells them the mistakes they’re making. After hearing what their kids have to say, will this couple redefine their co-parenting plan before their children pay the price? And, one of the world's leading researchers in cognitive psychology and a member of the Dr. Phil Advisory Board, Dr. Art Markman, talks about his book, Smart Thinking, and the three-part formula for employing effective learning and smart thinking in your daily life. Plus, Rachel is ashamed of a bad habit that has followed her since childhood. Don’t miss Dr. Markman’s five keys to breaking any bad habit!

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.desc: One of the most asked-about guests, Brandon, returns with an update.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jason and Brandy have been married less than a year, but they say the honeymoon is definitely over! His lying and flirting with other women has her addicted to snooping on him. Will they make it to their first anniversary or should they call it quits? Then, they've only been married for eight months, but Michael says his wife's violent temper is making his life a living hell. Dr. Phil shows them how to fight fair. Plus, a guest who's terrified of getting divorced … and he's not even married yet! Will he ever be ready to pop the question to his girlfriend?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is there such a thing as a forgivable lie? Today Dr. Phil talks to couples about working through the damage lies can cause in relationships. One woman says her husband lies so much that she’s ready for divorce. Also, this mom’s been divorced for two years and still hasn’t told her children. Is she living a lie? Plus, Dr. Phil tells you how to spot when your partner is deceiving you.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Good Luck Fixing Me, Dr. Phil!
programme.desc: Nikol says her husband of eight years, Mark, is arrogant, narcissistic, racist and homophobic. She says he belittles and humiliates her and has hit her -- a claim Mark denies. Nikol says some of Mark's outrageous behavior includes urinating on a woman, exposing himself to other men and driving drunk. She also believes that he's cheated on her and fathered children with other women -- but despite all of this, Nikol says she wants to stay with him! Mark claims he's only had emotional affairs, but admits to being a lousy partner and acting outrageously when he's drunk. He says even he wouldn’t want himself as a husband. Can Dr. Phil help break through Mark's tough exterior? When he digs into this couple’s past, he uncovers two troubled childhoods fraught with hardships and abuse. Can their marriage be saved, or are they better off apart?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Are we raising a generation of ungrateful children? Melissa’s sisters say her sons are the most spoiled boys in North America. They get everything they want – all they have to do is whine. Melissa says her kids just like toys, and she thinks her sisters may be jealous of her lifestyle. Next, Dori admits that her 13-year-old son, Parker, is spoiled. Parker says he won't take no for an answer, and even has a strategy for getting everything he wants. Find out what's behind Dori's need to spoil Parker. Then, Joan says her 14-year-old daughter, Jacquie, is a snob, and her need for trendy clothes is turning her into a materialistic monster. Plus, Lauren spends her entire paycheck shopping, but with no money in her checking account, she’s afraid she could be headed for trouble. Her mom, Diane, says she's not worried, it's just Lauren's way of relaxing.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his intervention with a family torn apart. Carole and Bill have been married 19 years and have six daughters. Carole is questioning whether she wants to stay married, and two of their daughters, Kristin and Jenny, accuse her of lying to them about another man in her life. They say their mother has turned into someone they don't recognize, and they're worried about how the family turmoil is affecting their younger sisters. The 18-year-old went into labor without even knowing she was pregnant. Are the two younger girls at risk as well?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: More and more newlyweds are declaring their honeymoon is over and they're ready to call it quits. One wife feels she's not the only woman in her relationship. And, Dr. Phil follows up with Shamika and Marlon to see if they are getting their marriage back on track.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Heather and Chris say their six-year marriage is on the brink of divorce because of their constant heated arguments, which they admit happen almost daily, in front of their two young children. Heather, a stay-at-home mom, says Chris is so controlling that he constantly accuses her of cheating on him, checks her phone records to see whom she’s calling and won’t let her handle their finances. Chris says Heather is only with him for the money and has gotten violent with him during their disagreements -- some of which have been caught on tape. He says she has kicked him in the privates, slapped him in the face and thrown a tape measure at his head -- all in front of the kids. What’s driving the couple’s anger? Plus, Chris recently filed for divorce -- will he change his mind and agree to work on their marriage? Then, Kerry says she and her husband, Sam, engage in explosive fighting at least four times a week, and she fears someone will get seriously hurt. Can this couple learn to fight fairly? This program contains strong language. Viewer discretion advised.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It's a mystery that has America absolutely baffled. An Idaho teenager and her younger brother with special needs vanish and have not been seen by anyone in almost four months. Their mother, Lori Vallow, appears completely unbothered by the fact that her two children are just gone, and is in Hawaii seemingly carefree with her fifth and newest husband, Chad Daybell, who reportedly has extreme religious beliefs. Adding to the mystery, four untimely deaths surround Lori and Chad, yet she still refuses to say a single word about her children’s whereabouts. How could these children just go missing for months without a trace? Where are they? Today, family members of Lori Vallow speak to Dr. Phil to try and shine a light on this unbelievable situation. Don’t miss it!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After all their hard work, the latest Dr. Phil Family receives some surprises from Dr. Phil! He informs Melissa that everything she needs to get her life back on track is headed her way: a complete health evaluation, personal trainer, nutritionist, and food service delivered to her door. In addition, she’ll receive help for her depression and be connected with a developmental disabilities specialist for her autistic son. But it all comes with a condition: Melissa and Randy need to heal their toxic relationship. Then, a talk with Myra and Gene leads to a tearful apology. And, will a one-on-one with Dr. Phil’s wife, Robin, help Myra see that she deserves to be treated with dignity and respect? Will Myra set some standards in her broken marriage? Will there even be a marriage to speak of when they get home? Dr. Phil has some strong words for Gene. Next, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity pits brother against brother as Edwin and Eugene audition for a Hollywood talent agent and a casting director. Don’t miss the surprising twist when they get a call from the judges. Then, it’s time to switch gears – literally! Since Myra and Melissa never learned to drive, Dr. Phil sets them up with a driving lesson so they can become more independent. And you won’t believe the prize in store for the women if they pass their driver’s test! Dr. Phil sits down with the entire family one last time. Will they use the tools he gave them to build healthier relationships?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Addiction, a disastrous condition that takes on other forms than drugs and alcohol. On today’s episode you’ll meet a “work-a-holic,” “food-a-holic” and “shop-a-holic.” Listen up as Dr. Phil gets to the real reasons behind his guests’ addictive behaviors. As Dr. Phil puts it, “Addiction serves a purpose.” Witness their dramatic revelations when the issues driving their compulsive behavior are uncovered, and learn what it will take to get their habits under control.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It's been weeks since Brandon's intervention and reluctant agreement to check into a drug treatment facility. Now, he and his family speak with Dr. Phil as they start the lifelong marathon of recovery.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his work with The Dr. Phil Family, an out-of-control, angry group with a long history of infidelities, betrayals and bitter resentments. Melissa’s boyfriend, Randy, joins the family at The Dr. Phil House, but Gene and Myra are not happy to see him. They think that Randy is a liar and a thief, and the reason Melissa has gained about 100 pounds in the last five years. Gene and Myra attempt to talk to Melissa about her weight, but Melissa is anything but receptive. Then, because they often blame each other for the chaos in the family, Melissa and Gene are assigned to bury the hatchet long enough to cook a family dinner together, without help from anyone else. Will these relatives be able to follow the rules? After dinner, a family meeting turns heated with accusations and tearful confessions. Dr. Phil joins the family and confronts Melissa and Randy about their sometimes violent relationship and Melissa’s mismanagement of her health. Can this couple create a nurturing relationship for the sake of their autistic child? Will Melissa do what it takes to gain control over her weight?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The mother/daughter relationship can take many forms: best friends, parent-child, and in the case of today’s guests, adversaries. You’ll meet one mom who’s driving her daughter crazy with constant phone calls and unexpected visits. Are her actions creating the separation she fears most? Find out how another mom’s money mismanagement has her daughter feeling both financially and emotionally at risk. Moms, daughters and trust - on the next Dr. Phil.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Imagine your weight getting so out of control that it confined you to your home, to a room, even to a bed. Dr. Phil's guests say they feel trapped and isolated in their homes and miss their loved ones.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil is addressing what he feels is a red alert crisis in America: drug and alcohol addiction, which affects 28 million addicts. Over the past 16 seasons, Dr. Phil has been able to help nearly 500 guests with inpatient treatment for substance abuse. Today, he will update some of their amazing recovery stories in hopes that they might inspire others who are struggling with addiction. Find out what happened to three sisters, Valeen, Amanda, and Tiffany, who were not only dangerously addicted to heroin, but also using it together every day. And what happen to Niki, who appeared on the show addicted, homeless, and pregnant? Niki returns to give her shocking update. Bethany said not even a medically induced coma and open heart surgery could get her to stop her dangerous heroin addiction -- find out how she’s doing now. Plus, numerous past guests and their families return to the Dr. Phil stage to share their amazing stories of recovery.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil explores a disturbing trend: Female teachers engaging in sex acts with their underage male students. The number of accusations has doubled in the past five years. You've probably heard of famous cases like Mary Kay Letourneau, Debra Lafave and the recent case of a teacher in Southern California, Meredith Johnson Vincent, who was arrested on suspicion of having a sexual relationship with a 14-year-old boy. Dr. Phil meets one teacher who has chosen to fight back.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his look at a teacher sex scandal that has a school and families divided in a small town in Texas. High school teacher Joelle Ogletree faces accusations of sexual misconduct with some of her male students. Hear both sides of this gripping sex scandal from the accuser and the accused, and judge for yourself if justice has been served.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Former high school dance teacher Anne, 35, made national headlines when it was revealed that her two children -- ages 3 and 2 -- were fathered by Bradman, a former student who is 14 years her junior. Bradman, now 21, is claiming that their physical relationship began when he was 15 and that Anne made the first move. Facing possible prison time on two felony charges, Anne turns to Dr. Phil to tell her side of the story. Why does she believe that she is the victim? And, why does she say she filed a protective order against Bradman? Then, Bradman takes the stage to tell his side of the story. Why does he say he didn't reveal the nature of their relationship sooner? And, why is he coming forward now? It's a don't miss Dr. Phil!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Does love really conquer all? James, 41, quit his job and left his wife and three children to pursue a relationship with his 18-year-old former student, Jordan. The couple says they're not breaking any laws, want to set the record straight with Dr. Phil, and want Jordan's mother, Tammie, to stop her Facebook "smear campaign" against them. In a national exclusive, Tammie confronts James for the first time on Dr. Phil’s stage. Find out how the attraction began and why Tammie says James is lying. Were there secret meetings before Jordan turned 18? And, what does Jordan stand to lose? Parents, how would you react if your child started a relationship with his or her former teacher?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In the summer of 2014, a former middle school English teacher was arrested on suspicion of statutory rape and contributing to the delinquency of a minor after police found her in a motel room with a 15-year-old former student. In a Dr. Phil exclusive, Jennifer Caswell speaks out for the first time. How does she explain her relationship with her former student?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Former teacher Tanya Ramirez pled guilty for crossing a forbidden line… having sex with a 17-year-old student who attended the school where she taught, and now, she’s done something many find even more unbelievable, she’s suing him and his mother. After pleading guilty to this charge, Ramirez filed a lawsuit against the teen accusing him of “extreme and outrageous” conduct and invasion of privacy for recording their late-night rendezvous. Ramirez claims the teen showed the tape around school for bragging rights. Ramirez says the sex was consensual, and says the student is an adult and he was just fine after the encounter. Teacher and student face off on Dr. Phil’s stage for the first time.

programme.title: The Devil Bat (1940)
programme.desc: A mad scientist develops an aftershave lotion that causes his gigantic bats to kill anyone who wears it.

programme.title: Filly Brown (2013)
programme.desc: FILLY BROWN is an inspiring and gritty portrait of a young artist striving to find her voice and seize her dreams without compromise. Majo Tonorio, aka, "Filly Brown" is a young, raw hip-hop artist who spits rhymes from the heart. With a mother in prison and a father struggling to provide for his daughters, Majo knows that a record contract could be her family's ticket out. But when a record producer offers her a shot at stardom, she is suddenly faced with the prospect of losing who she is as an artist, as well as the friends who helped her reach the cusp of success. Fueled by a fierce hip-hop score, FILLY BROWN is propelled by an exceptional cast featuring Gina Rodriguez, Lou Diamond Phillips, Edward James Olmos and the legendary Jenni Rivera in her final on-screen performance.

programme.title: The Gambler III: The Legend Continues (Part 1) (1987)
programme.desc: Brady Hawkes and Billy Montana join forces once again in this new adventure. This time around their goal is to help the Sioux fight the government and get the supplies they need. They also uncover corruption within a government outpost and find themselves in a dangerous position.

programme.title: Lazy Susan (2020)
programme.desc: Susan (Hayes) has always been the self-centered oddball in her family who lazily skated through life with their begrudging support until one day she wakes up to realize she's middle-aged with no job, no relationship, and an increasingly estranged family. She finally decides to take charge and turn things around, but never having done anything herself before, the struggle is real (and hilarious) as Susan becomes the woman she always wanted to be, all on her own.

programme.title: Day Of The Dead (1985)
programme.desc: A small group of scientists and soldiers have taken refuge in an underground missile silo where they struggle to control the flesh-eating horror that walks the earth above.

programme.title: Two Thousand And None (2001)
programme.desc: A man finds himself developing a new perspective on life once he finds out it's almost over. Benjamin Kasparian is a paleontologist of Armenian descent who has just split up with his wife Amanda. While trying to readjust to single life, Benjamin visits the doctor and is informed he's suffering from an unusual brain disease called Talbot's Syndrome, and he's not likely to live longer than five weeks. Benjamin is initially philosophical about his fate and decides to enjoy himself as much as he can in the time he has left - much to the disgust of Amanda, his best friend, his boss, and his new girlfriend, all of whom believe he should be taking the matter more seriously.

programme.title: Timecop (1994)
programme.desc: Max Walker, an officer for a security agency that regulates time travel, must fend for his life against a shady politician who's intent on changing the past to control the future.

programme.title: A Midnight Clear (1992)
programme.desc: As the end of World War II approaches, a group of American soldiers are assigned to watch activity amidst the stark snow-covered landscape of the French-German border and soon discover a battle-weary enemy as reluctant to fight as they are. With common ground established, the German platoon offer to be "captured" and a phony battle is staged to save honor. However, a tragic misunderstanding has devastating consequences in this powerful depiction of war's insanity.

programme.title: Before The Devil Knows You're Dead (2007)
programme.desc: Master filmmaker Sidney Lumet (The Verdict, Dog Day Afternoon, Serpico) delivers "one of his greatest achievements" (Roger Ebert) with this riveting and compelling suspense thriller. Oscar®-winner* Philip Seymour Hoffman (Capote) is Andy, an overextended payroll executive who lures his younger brother, Hank (Ethan Hawke, Training Day), into a larcenous scheme: the pair will rob a suburban mom-and-pop jewelry store that appears to be the quintessential easy target. The problem is, the store owners are Andy and Hank's real mom and pop, and when the seemingly perfect crime goes awry, the damage sends them hurtling toward a shattering clash that may obliterate their already precarious lives.

programme.title: A Room With A View (1986)
programme.desc: Touring Europe, Lucy Honeychurch meets free-spirited George Emerson. Returning home, she settles with the traditional Cecil Vyse until Mr. Emerson reemerges. Will she choose a safe, proper marriage to Cecil or the unpredictability of charismatic Emerson?

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E03 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!
